Container.Name: Curatio
Container.Overview:
Curatio picks what to watch from the movies and shows you already have on Plex or Jellyfin. It learns from what you've watched, builds rows like Because You Watched, Unwatched and Short Tonight, says why it picked each title, and plays the file in full quality on Apple TV, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows and the web.
Curatio Server runs next to Plex or Jellyfin; your media never moves. This container has its database built in. Free, private, no account with us. An AI key (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI or a local model) is optional.
Sign-in uses passkeys, which need HTTPS: put Curatio behind your reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Cloudflare Tunnel) with a domain, and set Base URL to that https:// address. The admin page works at http://[IP]:8000/admin with the admin password.
Container.Requires: A Plex or Jellyfin server, a free TMDB API key (themoviedb.org/settings/api), and a domain with HTTPS through your reverse proxy for app sign-in.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Port for the apps, the web player and the admin page. Point your reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, generated secrets and logs. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: The https:// address the apps use, without a trailing slash, e.g. https://curatio.example.com

Config.Name: TMDB API key
Config.Description: Free key from themoviedb.org/settings/api (the API Key, not the token).

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Password for the admin page, at least 16 characters.

Config.Name: AI provider
Config.Description: Optional. Which AI sharpens tags. Without a key, rule-based tags are used. Can also be set in the admin page.

Config.Name: Local model address
Config.Description: Optional, with AI provider 'local': an OpenAI-compatible address such as http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1 (Ollama).

Config.Name: Local model name
Config.Description: Optional, with AI provider 'local': the model name, e.g. qwen2.5:14b

Config.Name: Monthly AI limit (USD)
Config.Description: Stop AI tagging for the month at this spend. 0 = no limit.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: How many reverse proxies sit in front of Curatio (1 for SWAG or Nginx Proxy Manager).
